checklists.name: Kubernetes Cloud-Native Engineering Standards
checklists.description: Validation checklist for Kubernetes manifests, resource limits, liveness/readiness probes, and Pod Security Standards.

items.statement: Deployment manifests specify explicit CPU and memory requests and limits for every container.
Liveness, readiness, and startup probes are configured with realistic delay and timeout thresholds.
Pods comply with Restricted Pod Security Admission (PSA) standards (allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true).
Kube-linter or Datree static analysis verifies YAML syntax, deprecated API versions, and manifest best practices.
Helm charts or Kustomize overlays parameterize environment differences without inline hardcoded configs.
